meta.name: soot_junction
meta.prompt: A soot-blackened industrial town where the railway meets the canal.

character.label: soot-blackened canal and rail industrial hub

programs.brief: A colossal blackened-iron transshipment gantry crane spanning between the rail head and canal wharf, fitted with winch gear, rusted girders, and soot-caked coal hoppers.
A tall tapering industrial brick smokestack stained with soot, banded in iron reinforcement hoops and venting thick dark coal smoke.

tokens.terrain: a flat industrial corridor cut by a shipping canal meeting rail sidings and a marshaling yard
tokens.infra: railway_line running parallel to the water basin; towpath along the canal edge; iron_bridge crossing the canal
tokens.icons: brick factory chimneys venting black smoke; soot-stained brick warehouses; coal barges moored in the canal; rail loading gantries and sidings
